biotools.summary: SSCV DB is a database that systematically develops a registry of splice-site creating variants (SSCVs) utilizing massive publicly available transcriptome sequencing data. It facilitates the elucidation of novel biological mechanisms underlying splicing and serves as a valuable resource for drug discovery.
